choices.text: Few-shot examples are found by running gradient descent on the prompt tokens at test time.
Chain-of-thought asks the model for intermediate steps. Self-consistency samples several of those traces, usually at nonzero temperature, and majority-votes the final answer.
Zero-shot prompting gives the instruction and no examples. Few-shot prompting puts examples in the context. Neither one updates weights.
Self-consistency is a training algorithm. It backpropagates through every sampled trace and writes a new checkpoint.
